dispatch.title: Extract the payments facts
dispatch.task: Extract every operational fact from the payments docs under /work/docs, each with the file it comes from.
context: The docs are three short Markdown files under /work/docs: glossary.md, ledger-service.md and retry-policy.md.

worker.instructions: State each operational fact on its own line and cite its source file in the form (file.md).

params.split: Split into exactly 6 sub-tasks, two per document under /work/docs: for each document, one sub-task covers the first half of its lines and one covers the second half.

returns.shape: one operational fact per line, each ending with its source file in the form (file.md)
